metadata.title: chore: remove MySQL/MariaDB/MongoDB support - PostgreSQL and SQLite only
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- Remove all MySQL, MariaDB, and MongoDB database support from the entire codebase
- PostgreSQL is now the only supported production database; SQLite remains for local development
- 73 files changed, 135 insertions, 1,398 deletions

### Core code changes
- Removed MySQL/MariaDB engine configuration, advisory locks (`GET_LOCK`/`RELEASE_LOCK`), VARCHAR patching, and JSON query branches from `db.py`, `bootstrap_db.py`, `alembic/env.py`, `sqlalchemy_modifier.py`
- Added explicit `ValueError` for unsupported database backends in `build_engine()`
- Removed `pymysql` and `mariadb` optional dependency groups from `pyproject.toml`
- Changed default `db_driver` from `mariadb+mariadbconnector` to `postgresql+psycopg`
- Removed MongoDB URL detection from metrics service

### Infrastructure
- Deleted `docker-compose.mariadb.yml`
- Cleaned MariaDB/MySQL/MongoDB/PHPMyAdmin/mongo-express from debug and performance compose files
- Updated Helm chart `DB_DRIVER` default to `postgresql+psycopg`

### Tests
- Removed ~22 MySQL/MariaDB/MongoDB-specific test functions across 13 test files
- All 14,323 tests pass

### Documentation
- Rewrote `supported-databases.md`, `configuration.md`, deployment guides, and quick start
- Updated all docs to consistently communicate PostgreSQL for production, SQLite for development

### Alembic migrations
- Removed MySQL dialect branches from 4 migration files
- Updated MySQL/MariaDB comments in 8 migration files

Closes #1688

## Test plan
- [x] All 14,323 unit/integration/e2e tests pass
- [x] Verified no remaining MySQL/MariaDB/MongoDB references via grep (excluding CHANGELOG, intentional keeps like SQL injection test content and defensive URL masking regex)

commits.message:
chore: remove MySQL/MariaDB/MongoDB support, keep PostgreSQL and SQLite only

Remove all MySQL, MariaDB, and MongoDB database support from the codebase.
PostgreSQL is the only supported production database; SQLite remains for
local development.

Closes #1688

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix: remove residual MySQL references from Containerfiles and add test coverage

- Remove mysql extra from pip install in Containerfile and Containerfile.scratch
  (the mysql optional dep group was removed from pyproject.toml but these
  Containerfiles still referenced it, causing build failures)
- Remove stray mysql pattern from support_bundle_service.py URL sanitizer
- Add parametrized test for ValueError on unsupported database backends

Closes #1688

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
chore: remove spurious alembic extra from Containerfile

alembic is a core runtime dependency, not an optional extra — the
alembic extra group doesn't exist in pyproject.toml.  Align with
Containerfile.scratch and Containerfile.lite which already omit it.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
docs: add CHANGELOG entry for 1.0.0 GA release

Document removal of MySQL/MariaDB/MongoDB support as a breaking change
in the 1.0.0 GA release targeting 2026-03-31.

Refs: #3684, #1688

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix: scheme-agnostic URL redaction and postgresql+psycopg metrics detection

- Make support_bundle_service.py URL sanitizer scheme-agnostic so
  credentials in legacy/stale/misconfigured database URLs (e.g. mysql://)
  are still redacted in support bundles
- Fix metrics engine detection to recognize driver-qualified URLs like
  postgresql+psycopg:// (the canonical DSN in docker-compose.yml)
- Add test coverage for both fixes

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(metrics): use startswith for postgresql detection to avoid false positives

Substring matching ("postgresql" in url) would mislabel URLs like
sqlite:///tmp/postgres.db as engine="postgresql".  Use startswith()
with a tuple to match scheme prefixes only.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
chore: remove unused imports and variables after MySQL removal

Remove lock_id (bootstrap_db.py), VARCHAR (db.py), and orjson

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
